headline: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt models for multimodal agents and local deployment
summary: NVIDIA announced Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and two Bolt open models on Oct. 15; Bolt E4B was released on Oct. 23 for a roughly 4GB target. Its 8B-total/4B-effective checkpoint is based on Gemma 4 E4B-it, with Q4_K_M and BF16 versions, 64K context and configurable reasoning. NVIDIA publishes separate BF16 and Q4_K_M benchmark columns in the model card and hardware-specific serving measurements. Results are vendor-run and mixed: the Q4_K_M model trails Qwen 3.5 4B on several tool-use and long-context rows. No independent reproduction or task-level deployment evaluation was performed.
